sources.locator: Installed Cyberpunk 2077 2.31 release quest/scene assets, exact archive winners and binary SHA-256 recorded by research/cyberpunk/cache/game inventories; evidence points to individual native nodes.

evidence.locator: q003_01a_militech choice node 1351 option 0 (or warned-choice 2869 option 0) reaches hub2617 and handover section1844. Its output name2/ordinal0 writes q003_militech_chip +1 at node2752. English choice and two handover lines bind the transaction to Meredith actor1. This is acceptance at the initial meeting, not the later chip state.

Initial meeting choices1351/option2 and2869/option1 converge on refusal section2735 and writer2737 (q003_militech_refused +1); a distance-abandonment route also writes it. Therefore the meaning is declining/abandoning the offer, not a claim that V spoke one exact refusal line.

q003_08_stout writer2288 sets q003_stout_sex_done=1 after the outro chain. Node1767 waits for q003_07a_stout_sex_closer to exit; nodes1393/1743 restore/deactivate encounter state, nodes1993/2005 release restrictions,1697 ends the outro mix,1376 restores gameplay, then2288 writes completion. Meredith is the encounter actor. Cat and Johnny support entries in this resource are not treated as participants.

q110_08a_agent section659 gives the agent’s terms; choice671 option0 reaches hub4117 and exact writer712(q110_08a_netwatch_deal=1). A later callback writer547 adds1 to the same outcome. Both writers are positive acceptance, not proof the agent’s promises were fulfilled. EP1/mq055 initialization also establishes this save-history outcome; it is not proof the human selected the option during play. Private knowledge in this lane additionally requires V’s exact disclosure receipt.

q110_08a_agent diagnostic choices1263 and2429 precede section2434, which explains the repeated fake diagnostic result and writes q110_08a_virus +1 through output name2/ordinal0 at node966. The preceding warning/diagnostic scene is inspected. This is evidence the agent exposed the malware deception, not proof V accepted his deal or publicly disclosed it.

q110_14_alt section1022 contains V/Alt agreement and contact-channel exchange. The NetWatch-dependent branch1028 reaches sections714 or735; either section’s event output writes q110_made_contact_with_alt +1 at1027. This establishes contact on both routes. EP1/mq055 may initialize equivalent save history; neither shortcut nor fact alone grants another character private knowledge of the encounter.

Both orbital visitor scenes expose the same final decision. Hellman choice2038 and Takemura choice154 option0 directly set q201_ice=1; option1 directly sets q201_earth=1. The exact English localized options and outgoing socket destinations were joined to the writers. The rule does not infer which visitor appeared or that an eventual replacement body exists.

rules.statement: V accepted Meredith Stout’s Militech credchip at their initial meeting. Its malware was still present at handover; this history says nothing about later cleaning, copying, payment, or who won the Militech investigation.
V declined or abandoned Meredith Stout’s credchip offer at the initial meeting. No particular spoken refusal, later factory payment, or winner of the Militech investigation follows from that.
V and Meredith Stout completed their private motel encounter. It was an optional intimate meeting; it does not establish an ongoing romance, exclusivity, or a promise of another meeting.

The current save establishes that V accepted the NetWatch agent’s arrangement in the Grand Imperial Mall: let the agent leave with his data in exchange for removing the Voodoo Boys’ virus and releasing their trapped netrunners. Those were the offered terms, not a guarantee of later safety. V has disclosed this private history to the present listener.

The NetWatch agent warned V about the Voodoo Boys’ malware and demonstrated that V’s diagnostic was repeating a forged result. This does not establish whether V accepted the NetWatch bargain. V has disclosed the warning to the present listener.

The current save establishes that V and Johnny made contact with Alt beyond the Blackwall. Alt discussed a route into Mikoshi and supplied a way to contact her. This does not establish that Hanako, Placide, or another outsider witnessed it, nor any later ending outcome. V has disclosed this history to the present listener.

V signed the Secure Your Soul contract in the Arasaka orbital clinic, agreeing to digitization and storage while awaiting a suitable body. No future restoration or cure is established. V has disclosed this decision to the present listener.

V refused to sign the Secure Your Soul contract in the Arasaka orbital clinic and chose to return to Earth. This does not establish a later cure, date of death, or another ending. V has disclosed this decision to the present listener.
